summary: Retested the new Exit Game control on the Neon Highway Game Over screen (mobile, /arcade -> /arcade/highway). Backend pytest suite (49 passed) and frontend typecheck pass unchanged. The main generated check highway-exit-button-gameover-navigation covers all six acceptance criteria in one real play-through at 390x844: natural collision -> Game Over shows restart+leaderboard+exit buttons with exit positioned last in DOM order, labeled 'Exit Game'/'Spiel verlassen', >=48px tall, neon pink/purple classes present, no horizontal scroll; leaderboard modal opens/closes; restart hides Game Over and resumes the canvas; after a second natural loss, tapping Exit navigates in-SPA to /arcade and shows data-testid=arcade-hub (no app exit). Re-ran highway-lane-boundaries-and-alt-controls and arcade-hub-shows-two-playable-games/arcade-hub-public-preview as regression guards - all passed, confirming gameplay/gesture code is unchanged. One pre-existing, unrelated check (neon-highway-collision-gameover-restart) failed because it asserts a hard-coded German-language Game Over string without forcing locale, and this run's browser defaulted to English (unrelated to NeonHighwayGame.tsx/i18n-en.ts edits for this feature - i18n-en.ts only adds translations, it does not change locale defaulting, and lang-follows-device-locale-de-default still passes). Cross-checked the underlying engine behavior (score reset on restart) with locale forced to German in a new ad-hoc check (highway-restart-score-reset-de-locale) - passed, confirming no real regression in restart/score logic. Classified as a note/stale-check issue, not a product bug introduced by this change.

action_items: note (not a bug from this change): the pre-existing persisted check neon-highway-collision-gameover-restart hard-codes the German Game Over string ('Nur Trainingsrunde...') without forcing locale; this run's default browser locale rendered English ('Practice round only...'), so the check fails on a locale assumption, not on app behavior. lang-follows-device-locale-de-default (which does force/verify German) still passes, and the equivalent restart/score-reset behavior was independently confirmed passing with locale forced to German (see highway-restart-score-reset-de-locale). Recommend the main agent (or a future testing pass) update neon-highway-collision-gameover-restart to force locale='de' like the newer highway-exit-button-gameover-navigation check does, or assert on a locale-agnostic marker; left unmodified here per retest-mode rules since it is not one of this briefing's named criteria.
